subtasks.title: Create carry_patch_monitor.py with MonitorCycleResult dataclass
details: Create `packages/agentfox/agentfox/nightshift/carry_patch_monitor.py`.

Define `MonitorCycleResult` as a `@dataclass` with fields: `conflicts_detected: int = 0`, `conflicts_resolved: int = 0`, `conflicts_failed: int = 0`, `patches_merged: int = 0`, `rebuild_triggered: bool = False`.
Import `HubClient` from `afhub`, `AgentFoxConfig` from `agentfox.core.config`, and `NightShiftEngine` from `agentfox.nightshift.engine`.
Add module-level logger: `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)`.

subtasks.title: Implement CarryPatchMonitor.__init__ and in-memory retry counter
details: Define `CarryPatchMonitor.__init__(self, hub_client: HubClient, workspace_slug: str, config: AgentFoxConfig, engine: NightShiftEngine) -> None`.
Store all four arguments as instance attributes.
Initialize `self._retry_counts: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}` for per-`(slug, patch_id)` retry tracking.
Do not perform any I/O or async operations in `__init__`.

subtasks.title: Implement run_cycle dashboard fetch and merged_upstream detection
details: Implement `async def run_cycle(self) -> MonitorCycleResult`.
Step 1: call `await self.hub_client.get_patch_status(self.workspace_slug)`. On any exception, log the error and return `MonitorCycleResult()` (fail-open).
Step 2: iterate dashboard patches; for each with `status == 'merged_upstream'`, log an info message, emit `CARRY_PATCH_MERGED_DETECTED`, and increment `result.patches_merged`.
Step 3: if `self.config.carry_patch.auto_resolve is False`, log conflict count and return `result`.

subtasks.title: Implement run_cycle conflict detection, retry guard, and branch checkout
details: Step 4: iterate `PatchDetail` objects with `status == 'conflict'` in position order.
For each conflict patch, emit `CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_DETECTED` and increment `result.conflicts_detected`.
Check `self._retry_counts.get((self.workspace_slug, patch.id), 0) >= self.config.carry_patch.max_resolve_retries`; if so, log a warning and `continue`.
Call `await fetch_remote(patch.branch_name)` then `checkout_branch(patch.branch_name)` to prepare the local working tree.
Assemble the conflict resolution context dict (see REQ-4) and pass it to `engine._run_coder_session()`.

subtasks.title: Implement run_cycle resolution outcome handling and rebuild trigger
details: On successful coder resolution: commit changes, call `push_to_remote(patch.branch_name)`, call `await hub_client.submit_rebuild(slug)`, poll via `poll_rebuild()`.
Set `result.rebuild_triggered = True` and increment `result.conflicts_resolved`.
Emit `CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_RESOLVED` and `CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_REQUESTED` at the appropriate points.
On failed resolution: increment `self._retry_counts[(slug, patch.id)]`, increment `result.conflicts_failed`, emit `CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_FAILED`.
Return the fully populated `MonitorCycleResult` after processing all patches.
